stories.title: Flintshire road casualties fall to decade low, official figures show
stories.summary: The number of people hurt on Flintshire’s roads has fallen to its lowest level in at least a decade, but the number killed or seriously injured has barely changed. stories.title: No trains on North Wales line for a weekend in June as Flint flood work begins
stories.summary: No trains will run between Chester and Llandudno Junction for a weekend in June while engineers carry out flood-prevention work at Flint. stories.title: Recalled: the Maxi-Cosi base that may say it is secure when it is not
stories.summary: Parents are being urged to stop using a Maxi-Cosi child car seat base immediately after it was recalled over a fault that can make the seat appear safely fitted when it is not. The recall covers the Maxi-Cosi Family Fix Slide Pro Base, a black base used to hold a child car seat in place.
